caption: The drawing features a rectangular wooden plaque with a rough, textured surface, depicted in tones of light brown and gray to suggest aged wood grain. Mounted in low relief on the plaque is the profile of a human figure facing right. The figure has reddish-brown hair styled up, pale skin, a red mouth, an earring, and wears a green garment with a raised white collar featuring folds and detailing. The composition is centered on the page with a large plain area of off-white or cream background surrounding the framed plaque and relief profile.
title: Keystone from Ship's Woodwork
